text: This site is my catch up reference. Instead of digging through texts, bookmarks, and old emails, everything lives here and stays current.

title: Your Simple Guide
text:
How to use this site
Use the menu at the top to pick a section. Inside Homeschool, the sidebar on the left has the weekly assignment page and a page for each girl.
Everything here is public on the internet, so keep passwords and anything private off these pages.

text: Welcome, girls. Everything you need for school is on this site.

title: Homeschool
text:
Start your day here

Open This Week’s Assignments and read the whole page before you begin.
Go to your own page, Brailee or Addy, for your course links.
Work the subjects in the order listed. Check off each one as you finish.
Anything you could not finish or did not understand, write it down and bring it to me.

title: Homeschool
text:
House rules

School work happens before screens.
If you are stuck for more than fifteen minutes, stop and ask. Do not guess your way through a whole lesson.
Turn in work the same day you finish it.
Late or missed work gets made up on Friday.

title: About this site
text:
Your Simple Guide is a personal reference site. It collects links and instructions for different parts of my life so the people who need them can find them without asking me.
The site is built with Quarto and hosted free on GitHub Pages.

title: About this site
text:
Adding a new section

Make a new folder in the project, for example recipes/.
Add an index.qmd inside it with a title in the header block.
Add a link to it in the navbar section of _quarto.yml.
Run quarto render, then commit and push.

Keeping records
Save a copy of every graded assignment, test, and lab report in your school folder. At the end of the year we use those to build your transcript. If it is not saved, it did not happen.
